title: OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17610v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. translated_title: OpenDepth：重新利用图像编辑先验实现鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计
translated_abstract: 近年来，生成先验的融入彻底革新了单目深度估计（MDE）领域，以极高的数据效率实现了最先进（SOTA）的性能。然而，尽管基于文本到图像（T2I）模型的方法在一般场景中表现出色，但当面临开放世界中的环境扰动（如光照变化和恶劣天气）时，其效能会急剧下降。由于T2I先验是为语义合成而非保留像素级结构而优化的，它们在剧烈的视觉变化下难以将几何结构与外观解耦，容易引发结构性幻觉。因此，我们的核心见解是将开放世界深度估计建模为跨多风格图像的一致性几何推断，充分利用图像到图像（I2I）模型强大的结构保持编辑先验。基于此，我们提出了OpenDepth，一个鲁棒的开放世界单目深度估计框架，该框架引入……
tldr: 提出OpenDepth框架，通过重新利用图像到图像（I2I）模型的结构保持编辑先验，将开放世界深度估计建模为跨多风格图像的一致性几何推断，从而在光照变化和恶劣天气等环境扰动下实现鲁棒的单目深度估计。
en_tdlr: OpenDepth repurposes structure-preserving image-to-image editing priors to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, enabling robust monocular depth estimation under environmental perturbations such as illumination variations and adverse weather.
